name: DevAI
description: DevAI is a benchmark of 55 realistic automated AI development tasks designed to evaluate agentic systems, particularly in code generation. It includes rich manual annotations with 365 hierarchical user requirements and serves as a testbed for the Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation framework.
reputation: A small but practical benchmark for agentic software-development evaluation, mainly notable for its realistic tasks and Agent-as-a-Judge framing rather than broad community saturation.
notes: Provides a proof-of-concept testbed for Agent-as-a-Judge framework; includes hierarchical user requirements; focuses on automated AI development tasks.
